Luxury Contemporary Villa | District One

Discover refined living in this brand-new Type 2 contemporary villa, ideally located in the heart of District One, one of Dubai’s most exclusive residential communities. Designed with elegance and functionality in mind, this home offers generous space, privacy, and seamless indoor-outdoor living.

Property Details:

Contemporary Type 2 Villa
Brand New
Built-Up Area: 5,095 sq. ft.
Plot Size: 6,135.43 sq. ft.

Villa Features:

4 Spacious Ensuite Bedrooms with built-in wardrobes
5 Stylish Bathrooms with high-end finishes
Expansive open-plan living and dining areas
Private Elevator for added convenience
Floor-to-ceiling windows allowing abundant natural light

Outdoor & Community Highlights:

Private Swimming Pool
Landscaped outdoor areas ideal for entertaining
Direct Lagoon Access
Walking distance to the park
Additional Rooms & Benefits:
Maid’s Room and Driver’s Room
Premium contemporary design throughout
Located in a secure, prestigious community

Multiple units and layout options available

An exceptional opportunity to own a luxury villa offering tranquility, waterfront living, and close proximity to key destinations across Dubai.
